info.name: My Auctions - User Auction List
info.description: Get list of auctions belonging to the authenticated user

request.description:
Retrieve all auctions created by the authenticated user including:
- Auction details (ID, lot number, title)
- Current bidding status and prices
- Remaining time for each auction
- Auction status (pending, active, ended)
- Bid counts and highest bids
- Main images and creation dates

Requires JWT authentication token.
